unresolved: Different acquired gear, offers, upgrades, crate counts, materials and levels prevent balance equality claims; this single pair cannot separate RNG from gameplay differences.
Unity fixed 50ms simulation steps and Godot engine time scale/physics settings differ. Movement is scripted in both but coordinate paths, collision and target selection are not identical.
Reference clock covers whole-engine scaled processing; Unity clock covers active combat. Wall time and final simulatedSeconds are not comparable performance metrics.

Unity timer measurements overshoot configured values by 0.011-0.053s; reference sampled intervals undershoot by 0.154-0.496s. Capture/event sampling and simulation phase differ; frame-accurate timing equality is unverified.
Invulnerability, supplied weapons, accelerated time and scripted choices mean this is not an ordinary human full-run survival/control acceptance test.
Run traces do not establish every item effect or stack formula, hardware controller bindings, audio listening or persistent saves.
Reference kill/projectile counters were not instrumented; Unity counts cannot be compared to absent reference counts.
